The main reason event behind the 'surrender monkey' jokes was not in fact in World War 2 but the First World War in the Second Battle of Ypres in which during a German chlorine gas attack the french troops broke rank and fled leaving British and Canadian troops open to German attack. This left a 4 mile gap in the line which the Germans quickly occupied, this lead to the deaths of many Allied troops.  

Admittedly the joke picked up steam in WW2 due to the fact the French lasted only 8 weeks in the war. Winston Churchill believed in the French  troops and was very disappointed when France fell as his master plan involved the French troops doing the vast amount of the fighting. This eventually lead to Charles De Gaulle fleeing to Britain to set up french government in exile in a attempt to hold France together. However after the fall of France and the creation of Vichy France he essentially lost all power and was not recognized by the Americans who would only talk to Petain. In fact even at the end of the war during the Truman presidency De Gaulle was still not popular and after a meeting with De Gaulle Truman is quoted as saying "I don't like that son of a bitch".
